doc: Pushes the GTE matrix stack, sets the translation and rotation matrices from *m, then calls RotTrans(v0, v1, &flag) to transform v0/v1 (discarding the overflow flag), and pops the matrix stack. A thin wrapper around PSYQ libgte matrix-stack + RotTrans calls, likely used to compute a world-space rotate/translate for a single point/vertex relative to matrix m without permanently altering the current GTE matrix.
